verdict.rationale: Gemini's Deep Research feature performs in-depth, real-time web research across sources like Search, Gmail, and Drive (gemini-docs-7, gemini-docs-47, gemini-docs-29), and Connected Apps let it take permitted actions in other apps like Calendar, Maps, and Flights (gemini-docs-10, gemini-docs-19, gemini-docs-30). However, there is no evidence of a literal browser-automation agent that navigates and interacts with arbitrary websites (clicking, filling forms) to complete tasks — the actions are limited to a fixed set of first-party/connected apps rather than general web operation. Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous browser control/navigation on arbitrary websites, hands-on demonstration of multi-step website task completion, and independent corroboration of this capability.
